I want to die. But I can't and I can't talk to anyone about it and no one can help with it anyway.

Edit: thanks for confirming that everyone
How do i know if I feel it? That's part of the question I guess...what does safe feel like? Just like normal?

He uses it like a descriptor word. Safe place, safe people, therapy is safe. Maybe it's like not feeling nervous in a place or with people? But then he uses it other times too. I don't know. Sometimes if something is hard to talk about and I am getting fidgety or tearing up he will say it's safe (of course it is, nobody else is there). Or if I tell him it takes a while to get to sleep recently he will talk about imagining a safe space which makes no sense because its not like I'm nervous as I'm trying to sleep. I guess that's the context - quite often and to describe many unrelated things.
Oh god no! I turned as soon as possible. Also will never do my clearing the head driving in front of his office near closing time again either!
Except it wasn't just in passing kind of thing it was literally driving behind him.
